summary: John's maternal 4th great-grandfather; a bracciale (day labourer) of San Mango d'Aquino.
bio: Tree: Carmine G. Fiorillo (1808-1860) + Giuseppina Ferlaino (1811-1877); parents Domenico G. Fiorillo (1785-1849) + Maria Morrello (1786-1846). Son Domenico's birth act (27 Dec 1840): Carmine Fiorillo, 32, bracciale. Death act: died 17 Nov 1860, San Mango, aged 52 (born c.1808), bracciale; son of the late Domenico Fiorillo and the late Vittoria Marrelli/Morelli (Morti 1860 act 30). The tree's 'Maria Morrello' therefore has a different given name. His birthplace is unknown - the Fiorillos are absent from San Mango's 1674-1804 stati delle anime, so he may have been born elsewhere; his marriage act would say. The marriage of Carmine Fiorillo and Giuseppina Ferlaino (c.1828-40) was not completed: San Mango Matrimoni volumes an_ua37928564 / an_ua37928565 (c.1831-41).
